# Stefan's Gourmet Blog

> A culinary blog dedicated to fine dining restaurant reviews, sous-vide cooking techniques, Italian recipes, and wine pairings from around the world.

Stefan's Gourmet Blog features Michelin-starred restaurant reviews across Europe and Australia, extensive sous-vide cooking guides with precise time and temperature specifications, authentic Italian recipes (especially from Campania, Venice, and Tuscany), and expert wine pairings with focus on Burgundy, Riesling, and Italian wines. The blog combines professional culinary techniques with home cooking accessibility.

## Key Topics

- Sous-vide cooking techniques
- Michelin-starred restaurant reviews
- Italian cuisine and recipes
- Wine pairing recommendations
- Fine dining experiences
- Dutch and Netherlands dining
- Burgundy and Riesling wines
- Campania and Venetian cuisine
- Time and temperature cooking guides
- Tasting menus
- Wild boar and game meat
- Fish marinades and preservation
- Homemade pasta and ravioli
- BBQ and smoking techniques

## Michelin Restaurant Reviews

- [Dining in the Netherlands: Librije*** (2022)](https://stefangourmet.com/2022/05/07/dining-in-the-netherlands-librije-2022): Three Michelin star Librije restaurant review with 8-course tasting menu
- [De Bokkedoorns: Two Michelin Star Restaurant Review (2026)](https://stefangourmet.com/2026/02/28/de-bokkedoorns-restaurant-review): Two Michelin star De Bokkedoorns review near Amsterdam with dune views
- [Dining in Amsterdam: Vinkeles**](https://stefangourmet.com/2023/10/21/dining-in-amsterdam-vinkeles): Two Michelin star Vinkeles at Dylan Hotel Amsterdam restaurant review
- [Dining in Italy: D'O**](https://stefangourmet.com/2021/11/17/dining-in-italy-do): Two Michelin star D'O restaurant review by chef Davide Oldani near Milano
- [Dining in Australia: Hogget Kitchen](https://stefangourmet.com/2024/12/21/dining-in-australia-hogget-kitchen): Farm-to-table Hogget Kitchen review at Wild Dog winery Victoria Australia

## Sous-Vide Cooking Guides

- [Octopus Sous-Vide Time and Temperature](https://stefangourmet.com/2020/05/23/octopus-sous-vide-time-and-temperature): Sous-vide octopus cooking guide testing temperatures from 77-85°C
- [Smoked Brisket Sous Vide](https://stefangourmet.com/2022/12/23/smoked-brisket-sous-vide-2): Texas-style smoked brisket using sous-vide and cold smoking technique
- [Pulled Boar Cheeks Sous-Vide](https://stefangourmet.com/2020/03/01/pulled-boar-cheeks-sous-vide): Wild boar cheeks sous-vide with Italian dry rub and smoking technique
- [Wild Boar Ragù Sous-Vide (Ragù di Cinghiale)](https://stefangourmet.com/2015/12/13/wild-boar-ragu-sous-vide-ragu-di-cinghiale): Tuscan wild boar ragù sous-vide for pappardelle pasta sauce
- [Rack of Lamb Sous Vide with Slow-Roasted Cauliflower](https://stefangourmet.com/2022/04/15/rack-of-lamb-sous-vide-with-slow-roasted-cauliflower): Sous-vide rack of lamb with slow-roasted cauliflower and Burgundy pairing
- [Rabbit Ravioli (Ravioli di Coniglio)](https://stefangourmet.com/2023/01/08/rabbit-ravioli-ravioli-di-coniglio): Homemade rabbit ravioli with sous-vide filling and reduced rabbit stock

## Italian Recipes

- [Mushroom Risotto (Risotto ai Funghi)](https://stefangourmet.com/2020/01/31/mushroom-risotto-risotto-ai-funghi): Classic Italian mushroom risotto with dried porcini and carnaroli rice
- [Mackerel 'in Carpione' with Spaghetti Aglio-Olio-Peperoncino](https://stefangourmet.com/2019/06/22/mackerel-in-carpione-with-spaghetti-aglio-olio-peperoncino): Italian fusion mackerel carpione recipe inspired by Don Alfonso Campania
- [Mackerel 'in Saor' (Sgombro in Saor)](https://stefangourmet.com/2022/12/10/mackerel-in-saor-sgombro-in-saor): Venetian pesce in saor mackerel marinade with sweet-and-sour flavors
- [Potato Velouté With Mussels (Vellutata di Patate con Cozze)](https://stefangourmet.com/2023/04/09/potato-veloute-with-mussels-vellutata-di-patate-con-cozze): Italian potato velouté with mussels inspired by Sardegna Bistrot dish
- [Torta Caprese (Chocolate Almond Cake)](https://stefangourmet.com/2022/11/18/torta-caprese): Flourless Torta Caprese chocolate almond cake from Campania Italy

## International Cuisine

- [Char Siu Marinade From Scratch](https://stefangourmet.com/2024/07/12/char-siu-marinade-from-scratch): Homemade Chinese BBQ pork char siu marinade from natural ingredients
- [Homemade Mexican Chorizo](https://stefangourmet.com/2024/06/28/homemade-mexican-chorizo): Fresh Mexican chorizo recipe with dried guajillo chiles and spices

## Wine and Travel

- [Wine trip to Lombardia: Valtellina and Valcalepio](https://stefangourmet.com/2022/10/29/wine-trip-to-lombardia-valtellina-and-valcalepio): Lombardia wine tour exploring Valtellina and Valcalepio DOCG regions
